articles.author: Kaitlin Sullivan
articles.title: Drinking finally slows after pandemic spike, but not for every age group - NBC News
articles.description: Americans are drinking less for the first time since the pandemic, but alcohol use remains higher than it was before 2020, according to a study published Monday in the journal Annals of Internal Medicine.
